setup_details: uv project runs/ with Epoch's code installed from runs/vendor/eci-public (a byte-identical copy of ext/eci-public at e04929a), dependency versions taken from Epoch's uv.lock. Call fit_bayesian_eci(df, evaluate=True, random_seed=s, progressbar=False) for s in {12345, 22345, 32345}. evaluate=True adds the log_likelihood and posterior_predictive groups; the log prior is not stored by Epoch's code, so compute the summed log density of the three hyperpriors per draw (LogNormal log-pdf at the tau_alpha, sigma_median, tau_sigma draws) and store it as group log_prior. minimum_effect_size: 0.5 ECI points, or 0.07 of the model's published interval width where that is larger. Published values are rounded to 0.01; the published 500-draw file already differs from the published means by up to 0.88 points (0.053 x W) from Monte Carlo error alone.
failure_interpretation: A larger gap means the published file came from different code, data or settings (for example production overrides); find the cause before B2/B3, or switch the baseline to our own fit and say so in every result.

selection_rule: All models and benchmarks in the published fit input; no filtering of our own.
non_vacuity_check: The comparison can fail: the published file could come from production settings that differ from the public defaults, and the public loader already disagrees with the published fit input on three rows.
complete_outcome_accounting: Record each seed's sampler stage (pilot or cold), every attempt with its draws and diagnostics, warnings, and failed seeds.
independence_requirements: Same agent; recomputation of a third party's result, so no independence claimed.

Replicate seed = first 4 bytes of sha256('<generator>:<index>') as a big-endian integer (Python's built-in hash is salted and must not be used). Each replicate: simulate (M4), fit with fit_bayesian_eci(df_r, random_seed=seed, evaluate=False, progressbar=False), keep 400 evenly spaced draws, compute T1-T7 (M5) and, for G-null, the recovery indicator; write one JSON and one thinned .nc per replicate (M10). success_criterion: Recovery coverage over all non-anchor models in [0.85, 0.95]; at least 150 converged G-null replicates; T2 power >= 0.8 on G-2D and T5 power >= 0.8 on G-offset (at least 16 of 20 converged replicates); the positive-control prior fails at least one of S1-S4 in the frontier or all-models stratum on all three seeds.
minimum_effect_size: power >= 0.8 at family-wise alpha 0.01 for the targeted check; with 20 replicates, 16 of 20 has a 90% Clopper-Pearson interval of about 0.60 to 0.93, so power is reported with its interval.
failure_interpretation: Low recovery coverage means the published intervals are miscalibrated even when the model is true; low power means a B3 pass for that check is uninformative and is reported as 'no power'; a positive-control prior that passes S1-S4 means C1's rule is too lax.
compute_budget: 199 + 100 simulation fits + 3 positive-control fits = 302 fits. At Epoch's quoted 2 minutes per fit (4 chains on 4 cores) that is about 10 hours wall-clock (about 40 CPU-hours); restartable per replicate. Under 2 GB RAM. About 0.5 GB disk for thinned draws.
selection_rule: Planted effect sizes, generator definitions and the seed rule are fixed in M4 before any simulation; the developer and benchmarks receiving an effect are drawn from the replicate's seeded generator.
non_vacuity_check: The planted misfits are ones the checks can miss, and the positive-control prior is one C1's rule could pass; both outcomes have a stated consequence in G1.
complete_outcome_accounting: Every replicate is kept with its convergence status; non-converged fits are excluded from the null reference and from power, with counts per generator.
hidden_information_controls: Check code is frozen before generators are run; true parameters are written only to runs/B1/truth/, which the check code does not read.
independence_requirements: Simulation and analysis by the same agent; no independence claimed.

setup_details: Every fit: fit_bayesian_eci(df, priors=..., draws=4000, random_seed=12345, evaluate=False) (P0b uses seed 22345). P1-P7, X1, X2 need only BayesianPriors. P8-P10 need a model variant: runs/lib/variants.py supplies a builder with the same signature and variable names as build_bayesian_model and, inside a context manager, sets eci.bayesian.build_bayesian_model, eci.bayesian._FREE_VARS and eci.bayesian._DIAGNOSTIC_VARS to the variant's builder and variable lists (Epoch's dense-mass-matrix code indexes draws by those names); nothing under ext/ is edited. Step 1: fit P0 and P0b and compute the noise floor; if P0b against P0 has any model with relative shift above 0.05 or any adjacent-pair probability change above 0.03, double draws for all B2 fits once. Step 2: S5 screen on P0 (M3). Step 3: fit each grid entry and score S1-S4 against P0. The screen never changes the grid; it can only add the two power-scaled refits named in the C1 rule.
success_criterion: C1 decision rule: all ten priors resolved, S1-S4 pass in the all-models, frontier and sparse strata, and S5 passes (or its two follow-up refits pass S1-S4).
minimum_effect_size: 0.25 x a model's baseline 90% interval width: 1.1 to 1.9 ECI points for the 20 frontier models (published widths 4.24 to 7.56), and up to 10.5 points for the widest sparse model (width 41.8).
failure_interpretation: See C1 decision_if_unproven: a sparse-only failure narrows C1; a frontier or all-models failure falsifies it.
compute_budget: 14 fits at draws=4000 (P0, P0b, P1-P10, X1, X2), roughly 3 to 5 minutes each, plus up to 2 follow-up fits and the screen: 1 to 1.5 hours wall-clock.
selection_rule: Grid chosen from Epoch's stated priors: each hyperprior centre moved by a factor of 2 each way, widths doubled, and the structural alternatives a reviewer would raise (proper, hierarchical, non-pooled). Frozen in prior-grid.json.
non_vacuity_check: B1's positive-control prior must fail S1-S4; otherwise G1 tightens S2 once, and if it still passes C1 is capped at exploratory.
complete_outcome_accounting: Every grid entry reported. A fit that fails Epoch's convergence checks is retried once with draws doubled (P9 may switch to a non-centred parameterisation for the retry), then reported as unresolved.
hidden_information_controls: Grid, metric code and thresholds frozen (digests in runs/freeze.json) before any refit or screen.
independence_evidence: None claimed; confirmatory status rests on pre-registration, not independence.
